cut.title: Listen & Cut
cut.hintTeam: teams are never mixed (except in all-talk)
cut.laneHint: Drag here (or Shift+drag on waveform) to select clip ranges — or press C
cut.rangeTip: Cut #{n}: {a}–{b} in this preview. Click to jump there, drag edges to adjust.
cut.noRanges: Select one or more ranges on the cut bar above to export.
about.desc: Extracts the players' voice from CS2 demos, so you can listen per round and per team and send clips and a report to FACEIT.
about.license: Free and open source, under the MIT License.
about.idea: The idea came from csgo-voice-extractor by akiver.
about.uses: Built with demoinfocs-golang, WebAssembly, opus-decoder (Opus), and wasm-media-encoders (LAME).
recent.title: Recent demos
recent.clearConfirm: Delete every saved demo, with its marks and cuts, from this browser?
recent.note: Saved only in this browser, voice included, and deleted after 7 days without opening.
left.title: Listen
left.selectSome: Select rounds and players to listen.
right.title: Export
right.bothTip: Only for all-talk moments (halftime, overtime breaks): select only those rounds first
right.bothDisabledRow: Both teams only hear each other in all-talk moments
right.audioTip: Put this player's voice in the audio
right.reportTip: Mark as reported: named in the report and gets a file with only their voice
right.isolated: Separate file for each reported player (only their voice)
right.matchIdTip: Put the FACEIT match ID in front of every file name, to keep evidence from several matches apart
right.selectPlayers: Select the players whose voice goes in the audio.
right.nothing: Nothing to export: nobody selected talks in these rounds.
